text:
sam: GearboxOps flagged a ~18% delta vs our marketplace meter for 2026-03-21 18:00-20:00 UTC. They say their sidecar applies sample_rate=0.82 and "quantize=round_down_10". Can partnerships + metering sanity-check? :eyes:
nina: ack. do we have the partner excerpt?

sam: they pasted a tiny diff in the ticket:```
2026-03-21T18:00Z,our_billable,gearbox_billable
2026-03-21T18:00Z,500,410
2026-03-21T19:00Z,620,508
```

ariel: those rows imply ~0.82 multiplier and rounding to tens. quantize could drop small counts causing systematic undercount. Are device ids present in the sample?

sam: yes, anonymized device_id present but consistent. Gearbox said they can provide minute-level raw counts for a 48h window if we accept a redacted addendum (they treat device IDs as PII).

michael: immediate options: 1) run an inverse-adjustment heuristic (apply /0.82 and un-quantize) in recon and propose credits (fast but risky), 2) request raw minute-level + exporter config and run side-by-side rollups (audit-friendly), 3) add partner-metadata handling in reconciliation so future ingest normalizes using sample_rate+quantize flags.

nina: long-term 3) is the right move. short-term we need preliminary numbers for their finance team before EOD. can we do 2) quickly if they upload?

ariel: yes. if they provide minute traces and exporter config we can: ingest -> run our canonical rollup -> simulate their sidecar transformation (sample + quantize) -> compute per-device multipliers and delta. that gives a defensible audit trail.

sam: gearbox asked if we can accept base64 gzipped ndjson uploads to s3. they prefer that to avoid sharing raw CSVs. legal-bot: template ok?

legal-bot: we have a partner-data-redacted addendum template. to proceed we need exact s3 prefix, TTL, and ACL. we recommend TTL=7d and ACL limiting access to the staging-recon role.

ariel: propose staging prefix: s3://partners-staging/gearbox/recon/2845678901/. I'll create presigned upload URLs with putObject and set ACL to private and bucket policy restricting to recon role.

billing-bot: Billing alert created: partner=gearbox id=GB-4420 window=2026-03-21 status=open impact=~$2,100

ariel: ops plan checklist:
- create staging prefix (s3://partners-staging/gearbox/recon/2845678901/)
- provide presigned upload + retention TTL=7d
- ingest ndjson.gz -> sandbox recon account
- run our_rollup --window=2026-03-21T16:00Z/2026-03-22T04:00Z --granularity=minute
- run simulate_sidecar --sample-rate=0.82 --quantize=round_down_10 --device-shuffle=false
- diff -> per-device multipliers + audit csv (signed hashes)

sam: i can own the simulate_sidecar script and run diffs. nina, can you own partner comms and acceptance of addendum?

nina: yes. i'll ask for ndjson.gz upload and exporter config (sample_rate, quantize mode, exporter commit sha). request: include a small signed sample (HMAC) of the bundle for integrity.

michael: timeline? if gearbox uploads within 90m we can produce preliminary recon in ~2h. alternatively, if they cannot share traces, do we want to try a conservative heuristic estimate for EOD?

sam: i'd rather avoid heuristics. propose telling Gearbox: provide upload + addendum and we'll aim for preliminary numbers same day. if they absolutely can't, offer a provisional estimate with clear caveats and no auto-credit until validated.

nina: drafting message now. legal-bot: i'll attach the addendum and ask for acceptance via signed email.

legal-bot: addendum ready. liaise with gearbox and return signed copy to legal@redwood.ai. once signed we'll provision presigned URLs.

ariel: provisioning staging now. job id: staging-2845678901. will post presigned URLs here in 10m. :rocket:

sam: leaving a small note for auditing: when we compute multipliers, include both per-device and aggregate multipliers plus the simulated-step logs so we can replay the transform during disputes. sign the audit CSV with our HSM key.

michael: good call. also record exporter commit sha to correlate quantize behavior across releases.

nina: sent comms to gearbox with addendum + upload instructions. asked for minute-level ndjson.gz for 2026-03-20..2026-03-22 and the exporter config. requested signed sample HMAC and commit sha.

sam: starting simulate script prep. will ping when recon ready.

ariel: presigned upload URLs posted to gearbox ticket (expires in 8h). waiting for upload.

gearbox-ops (via nina): "upload complete. bundle includes minute.ndjson.gz (48h) + config.json + sample.hmac + exporter_sha"

ariel: ingest succeeded. running canonical rollup now. job id: recon-2845678901-1

sam: running simulate_sidecar with sample_rate=0.82 quantize=round_down_10 now.

ariel: recon diff finished. preliminary delta ~17.9% undercount on partner side; per-device multiplier distribution attached to ticket (summary: median 1.219, mean 1.228, outliers at 1.5). producing signed audit CSV and draft adjustment proposal (credits vs entitlement normalization).

michael: thanks. nina, present options to gearbox: 1) immediate one-off credit for validated window (with audit CSV), or 2) update entitlement mapping to accept gearbox metadata and normalize future batches (preferred). Also propose a quarterly sync to ensure exporter changes are communicated before deploys.

nina: sent options. gearbox prefers credit for this window + roadmap item to integrate metadata normalization. they asked for reconciliation report and proof-of-simulate. attaching signed audit CSV now.

billing-bot: Flagging manual credit review: partner=gearbox id=GB-4420 amount_est=~$2,110 status=pending_approval

ariel: marking this thread resolved for operations. follow-up tickets: ENG-1128 (entitlement-normalization feature), COMMS-227 (partner exporter upgrade cadence).

sam: closing loop: saved signed audit artifacts to s3://partners-audit/gearbox/2845678901/ and pushed HMAC-signed report to ticket.

nina: thanks team. we'll schedule a 1-hr postmortem with gearbox next week to align exporter's change process. :white_check_mark:
